description: Submete uma attestation LGPD/GDPR on-chain no compliance-registry program (create_attestation legacy path, sem ZK). Server wallet assina como issuer. Para ZK-verified use submit_verified_compliance_attestation.

commitmentHex.description: Commitment de 32 bytes (hex, 64 chars). Se omitido, usa sha256(commitmentText).

commitmentText.description: Texto a ser hashed via sha256 pra gerar o commitment. Usar OU commitmentHex OU commitmentText.

storageUri.description: URI off-chain pra o documento (DPIA/audit report). Max 128 bytes.

name: submit_compliance_attestation
